answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 19764 Country: India Title: Can we name the Baby Boy as "Afraz" is it correct and what is the meaning of Afraz? Question: Asalam walekum : Can we name the Baby Boy as "Afraz" is it correct and what is the meaning of Afraz? Answer ID: 19764 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 416/340/B=1431) Yes, you can keep this name, it is correct Islamically. It means: one who lifts, elevates, as it is said (سرافراز) i.e. one who holds head high. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
